headline: Paramount closes Warner Bros. merger to form Skydance
summary: Paramount completed its merger with Warner Bros., forming a new company called Skydance that brings together Paramount+, HBO Max and networks like CBS and CNN, after a last-ditch effort to stop the deal failed.

claims.statement: Paramount's merger with Warner Bros. has closed, creating a new company named Skydance.

sources.quote: Paramount closes historic Warner Bros. merger to form Skydance
New media empire will be known as Skydance, with CEO David Ellision calling it a 'historic day.'
Paramount now owns Warner Bros. as last-ditch effort to stop $111B merger fails.

claims.statement: The deal brings together Paramount+, HBO Max and networks including CBS, CNN, MTV, TBS, Comedy Central and Food Network.

sources.quote: The deal brings together two major streaming platforms, Paramount+ and HBO Max, along with networks including CBS, CNN, MTV, TBS, Comedy Central, and Food Network.

discrepancies.explanation: engadget values the merger at $110 billion while arstechnica puts it at $111 billion.

quotes.quote: Controversial $110 billion mega-merger of Paramount and Warner Bros. finally closes
Paramount completes $111B Warner merger, creating “Skydance” behemoth
